# CG-REQ-002: Request parameter became required

An existing optional parameter is now required.

**Why it matters:** Requests that omitted an optional parameter become invalid.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Detects | `parameter.requiredChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} became required.
>
> Consumers that omit this parameter will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the parameter optional with a documented default, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: limit became required

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: limit, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}]
+       parameters: [{name: limit, in: query, required: true, schema: {type: integer}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. GET /x: query parameter "limit" became required.

### Does not fire: became optional

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: limit, in: query, required: true, schema: {type: integer}}]
+       parameters: [{name: limit, in: query, schema: {type: integer}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
